owned_invariants: The task is edges, a nonempty list of pairs of integers on the vertices 0 to n-1, values, one exact integer or null for each edge, and optionally guard_rows, integers that each name a row of the cycle matrix S, which has one row for each fundamental cycle of the graph. A task that is not of this form is refused before anything is asked.

guard_complete is recorded first: the guard rows, by default every row, have the rank of S. A guard that does not is refused as PARTIAL_GUARD with a kernel_witness, the unit vector of the chord of the first row the guard leaves out, and the syndrome of that vector under the guard and under S.

The first stage is asked up to twice, as stage1:0 and stage1:1, for {slots: {edge: integer}} naming each null edge by its index and no other edge. The syndrome S c of the filled cochain is the verdict. The second ask carries the first syndrome in its prompt, after the line Guard syndrome:.

A reply with abstain true is judged by the rank test. abstention_matches_rank_test holds when the rank of the slot columns of S differs from the rank with the column of what the fixed values leave over. A false abstention is refused as FALSE_ABSTENTION. A true one is the typed refusal ABSTAIN_NOT_MATERIALISABLE. Both carry the two ranks.

guard_green_within_one_retry holds when the syndrome of the first fill is zero, or of the second. Otherwise the run is refused as GUARD_RED_AFTER_RETRY with every syndrome. A step with no reply is refused as NO_ADMISSIBLE_REPLY, naming the stage.

The second stage is asked with the filled values and answers {potential: [integer, ...]}, one exact integer for each vertex. stage2_potential_explains_slots holds when the coboundary of the potential is the filled cochain. The run is certified as MATERIALISED after one fill and MATERIALISED_AFTER_RETRY after two, with the syndromes and the residual.
boundaries: A materialisation says the filled values close every cycle and that the potential explains them. It does not say the fill is the only one: any exact integers that close every cycle are accepted.
Slots are filled with integers. A task whose slots can be filled only with a fraction has no fill.
The guard is checked for rank only. A guard that is complete says nothing about the values.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed requests, exact unbounded integers and rationals, no float, no unwrap or expect.
